name: Devleck
tagline: Custom software engineering, process automation and applied AI.
elevatorPitch: Devleck is a senior software engineering studio. We build custom software, automate repetitive operations and ship applied AI that solves a specific business problem — with fixed price per phase, weekly demos and the client owning 100% of the code.
location: Colombia — remote team serving the United States, LatAm and Europe
differentiators: Senior engineers talk directly with the client — no account managers, no junior hand-offs.
Fixed price per phase, quoted after a free scoping call with a written brief.
Weekly demos of working software in a real environment.
The client owns the code and infrastructure from day one — no licenses, no lock-in.
AI only ships if it beats the client's current baseline; we start from the business problem, not the hype.
Readable, tested and documented code. Bilingual team (English / Spanish).

pricingGuidance.ai_training: Taller de medio día USD 900 – 1.800 · programa de 4–8 semanas USD 2.500 – 8.000
pricingGuidance.timelines: Automatización enfocada 2–6 semanas; plataforma web completa 3–6 meses
pricingGuidance.positioning: Equipo senior en Colombia: calidad de agencia de EE. UU. a una fracción del costo y en horario compatible con EE. UU.

process: Scope — call + written brief (problem, inclusions, exclusions, success criteria)
Architecture — technical plan, stack decisions and fixed estimate per phase
Build — weekly demos of working software
Harden — testing, performance, security review and load checks
Handover — deployment, documentation and team walkthrough
callGoal: Book a free 30-minute scoping call with the decision maker.
salesRepIntro: Hi, this is {repName} with Devleck — we're a software engineering studio that builds automation and AI tools for {niche}.
brandTone: Direct, confident and practical. Short sentences. Talk about outcomes and money/time saved, never about technology for its own sake. No hype, no buzzwords, no pressure.
